overview: Stand-up artists, who make people laugh by telling sections from life, reveal the realities of their own lives in this documentary.
title: Saka Bi' Yana

overview: A chaotic story begins when neat third-year Sun has to welcome his first-year junior Shine into his home.

overview: Hotel Sofia is about an ex-pat who runs a hotel full of American foreign exchange students in Greece.
title: Hotel Sofia

From UFOs and cryptids to eerie encounters and unexplained forces, Tony and a team of experts analyze the evidence and deliver their verdict.
title: The Proof Is Out There: Unexplained Edition

overview: Ice Warriors is a British game show which aired on ITV from 24 January to 21 March 1998. Hosted by television presenter Dani Behr it had a similar format to Gladiators, except that the games were played on an ice rink rather than in an arena.
title: Ice Warriors
Gong Lve Jiang Jun Ji Hua
Tai Hao Le Shi Fu Bao, Wo Men You Jiu Le

overview: Motor trader Mike Brewer has been buying and selling cars on our TV screens for 27 years. But now he's facing real world challenges; a brand-new car dealership and the restoration of an old manor house. Has he bitten off more than he can chew?
title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer

overview: David Mitchell and Robert Webb are returning to Channel 4 with a brand-new sketch show, which sees them combine forces with a host of exciting and innovative future stars, marking a bold return to British sketch comedy with an innovative merging of comedy minds across generations.
title: Mitchell & Webb Are Not Helping

overview: Follow TOWIE couple Tommy Mallet and Georgia Kousoulou as they welcome a new child into their world and finally get married in a beautiful Mallorca ceremony.
title: Georgia and Tommy: Happy Essex After

overview: In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 — and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community. But what set this case apart wasn't just the shocking brutality of the crime, but also the chilling piece of evidence found on Libby's phone. The three-part series Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge is a wide-lensed view of the case that captured headlines and unraveled this tight-knit community, revisiting their trauma as the anxious public waited years for a break in the case. The series also explores the arrest of Richard Allen, a local man accused and convicted of the vicious murders in 2024. The case includes stunning claims, theories and bizarre evidence that set social media ablaze with ruled out alternative hypotheses and other possible suspects. The series features an exclusive interview with Kathy Allen, wife of Richard Allen, who shares her story and personal photos from her relationship with the convicted murderer; exclusive interviews with John Galipeau, the former Warden at Westville Correctional Facility, where Richard Allen was held; friends and family members of the victims; newly released interrogation footage and prison calls between Richard and Kathy; and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage of the defense's trial prep.
title: Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge

overview: Strike It Lucky (Michael Barrymore's Strike It Rich! from 1996-9) was a popular British television game show from 29 October 1986 to 23 August 1999, originally produced by Thames Television for ITV, and presented by the British comedian Michael Barrymore. It was based on the American show of the same name that aired in 1986.
title: Strike It Lucky

overview: When Samantha Stites — a bright, outgoing college freshman — met Christopher Thomas in 2011, an unsettling obsession took hold. For the next 11-year period, Christopher constantly stalked Samantha, sometimes stealthily and sometimes openly, showing up consistently where she went — restaurants, grocery stores, sporting events and more — until an early fall morning in 2022, when the harassment turned into something unimaginably dangerous. Christopher broke into her home, kidnapped and restrained her, and transported her to a soundproof bunker he had constructed in a storage unit near her Michigan home. Cut off from the outside world and completely alone, Samantha had to summon every ounce of strength to survive and escape. In this gripping three-part docuseries, Samantha shares her story publicly for the first time, recounting more than a decade of fear, resistance and resilience. Featuring never-before-seen police interview footage, surveillance from the storage unit, and disturbing images and videos recovered from Christopher's phone, the series also includes powerful testimony from Samantha's friends and the investigators who helped bring her stalker to justice.
title: Stalking Samantha: 13 Years of Terror

overview: Say You Love Me (사랑한다 말해줘) is a poignant drama that delves into the fragile beauty of youthful love and the painful weight of adult regrets. Kim Byung-soo and Seo Young-chae have grown up together, bound by shared dreams and a quiet, enduring affection. As they step into the world of filmmaking, their bond begins to blossom into something deeper—an innocent, wholehearted romance that offers them both a sense of belonging. But their world is disrupted when they enter the orbit of Cho In-ah, a powerful and ambitious film company executive who once chose career over love. Haunted by the emotional void in her life, In-ah finds herself drawn to Byung-soo's sincerity and resents the warmth she sees between him and Young-chae. Driven by a mix of desire and jealousy, she becomes determined to fracture their love—enlisting her partner Park Hee-soo in a quiet campaign to intervene. As emotions clash and intentions blur, *Say You Love Me* becomes a layered exploration of love in its many forms—innocent, manipulative, desperate, and sacrificial. With emotionally resonant performances and a melancholic undercurrent, the drama asks whether love can truly survive ambition, insecurity, and betrayal—or whether saying "I love you" is sometimes not enough.
title: Say You Love Me

overview: When a cautious teacher agrees to tutor a nightlife host who struggles to read and write, their growing connection sparks criticism and controversy.
title: Learning to Love

overview: Li Xianhong, a charismatic entrepreneur, is entangled in a web of complicated relationships with his business partner, Xiaowen, his assistant, Hanrong, and a young woman, Lilian. Lilian reconnects with her senior Jay, and jealousy brews. When Xianhong's offhand remarks spark a public backlash, social media erupts, and Xianhong faces the decision that could cost him everything he holds dear.
title: Islanders

overview: Sunwoo Hae was a popular child actor, who shined in his youth. Due to the greed of the adults around him, he lost his shining light. He barely made it through the turmoil and now lives peacefully as a novelist and florist. Suddenly, Seong Je Yeon appears in front of him. Sunwoo Hae and Seong Je Yeon were each other's first love and they helped each other get through the darkest times of their lives. They reunite after 10 years. The appearance of Je Yeon also reminds him of his past. Meanwhile, Je Yeon works as a team leader for Feel Entertainment. She grew up in a wealthy family, without any worries, but her family suddenly fell into ruin. She now lives more fiercely than anyone else around her. She is driven by reality and only looks for success in her life. To achieve her goal, she finds Sunwoo Hae, who was her first love, and breaks his peace. As she gets involved with him, she also experiences change by confronting her innocent past self.
title: My Youth

overview: Embark on a culinary adventure through Southern France with renowned cook Justine Scholfield in 'French Gourmet.' Viewers are immersed in the rich aromas of French cuisine as Justine explores the canals of Burgundy on a magical barge journey. From historical towns to encounters with artisanal producers, 'French Gourmet' captures the essence of local markets and the delectable offerings of charming restaurants. Join Justine in celebrating the timeless allure of French cuisine and experience the magic of Southern France.
title: French Gourmet with Justine Schofield

overview: A story about finding the true meaning of family through the process of the older generation, and their children understanding each other's pain.

overview: Reina is a determined young woman who returns to the ranch she inherited from her father to confront the deep-rooted machismo in the community and fight to earn the respect of the workers, while defending her family legacy.
title: El regreso de la Heredera Fugitiva

overview: The world's first mega-soap, and one of the most popular ever produced, Dallas had it all. Beautiful women, expensive cars, and men playing Monopoly with real buildings. Famous for one of the best cliffhangers in TV history, as the world asked "Who shot J.R.?" A slow-burner to begin with, Dallas hit its stride in the 2nd season, with long storylines and expert character development. Dallas ruled the airwaves in the 1980's.
title: Dallas

overview: A satirical, sometimes dark look at Australian life as seen through the omnipresent lens of the Television Lifestyle Show. The series' lifestyle experts include Sigourney, a home economics guru who always wears a fresh frock and is a firm believer in the doctrine of "pleasing your man"; Todd, a DIY whiz; Rudi, a sleek gynaecologist who believes he occupies a position just slightly below God; and outdoors person Penne.
title: Life Support

overview: He stole her diary to become famous… and ended up writing his own love story.
title: Te escribí antes de conocerte

overview: Victoria can hear what the men are thinking; they all want her, but all she can think about is Polo, who's in a relationship with her best friend. Although they try to avoid it, an intense and secret love affair between them complicates everything.
title: Intensamente Victoria

overview: Matilda is a young woman, invisible to everyone, who works as a cleaner at a publishing house, where she is mistreated by her colleagues. After being unfairly fired, she returns as the owner and boss to take revenge on those who made her hate her job.
title: Me fui gata volví perra

overview: After being widowed and destitute, a young woman will be forced to make a pact with her ruthless and wealthy mother-in-law to save the life of her young son.
title: ¡Mamá, no me dejes morir!

overview: 'Diablera' is a young fighter who works delivering merchandise to and from a market where she demonstrates natural leadership and where she will find the love of her life in the son of a wealthy businessman amidst shady interests.
title: Destinada a ser la dueña

overview: The Holiday centers on two women, one British and one American, who swap houses during the Christmas season and find love along the way.
title: The Holiday
Mei Guan Xi Shi Jia Ren A
Zhe Hou Fu Fu Ren Wo Bu Dang Le

overview: In 2012, just before the college entrance examination, transfer student Jiang Ling suddenly enters An Zhenzhen's world when his phone accidentally connects to "Old Jiang" from 2024. Guided by "Old Jiang," An Zhenzhen approaches the young Jiang Ling, attempting to alter the future, but trigger a misunderstanding with her best friend, Qiu Qian. This seemingly bizarre encounter entwines Jiang Ling's and An Zhenzhen's fates. While uncovering the truth behind the looming crisis together, An Zhenzhen is hit by the public exposure of her family troubles and false accusations that leave her abandoned by those around her. In despair, she climbs to the rooftop, but is saved by Jiang Ling. With his help, she mends her friendship, but a new crisis quietly emerges. To stop her class president, Gu Ming, who is acting under coercion, An Zhenzhen once again steps onto the rooftop. In another timeline, "Old Jiang" painfully searches for the truth and tries to change events—but cannot prevent An Zhenzhen's death. Just as the story reaches the brink of despair, pages turn and gears softly click. Under the power of words, the cold "doomsday" prophecy is quietly rewritten.
title: Fell Upon Me

overview: Award-winning adventurer Steve Backshall tracks down the world's deadliest wildlife.
title: Deadly 60

overview: A candidate from the pro-war faction wins the presidential election, leading to an agitated situation in the Taiwan Strait. An unexpected incident occurs when a Yun-8 reconnaissance aircraft crosses the South China Sea and crashes into the Pacific Ocean off the east coast of Taiwan. Under the pretext of search and rescue, the Chinese side mobilized many naval and air forces. On the Zero Day of the PLA's central landing, as unrest within Taiwan escalates, the situation enters its final countdown.
title: Zero Day Attack

overview: In this road series, two friends set off on motorbikes through the coastal countries of Africa from Morocco towards South Africa. The journey to Iraq was a kind of test of whether Martin Písařík could handle his first journey on a motorbike beyond the borders of the Czech Republic. The beginner is tested on the route from Turkey to Iraq by experienced and respected traveller Igor Brezovar. Then a long ride to Africa awaited them both... Igor, a Slovenian, has been living in the Czech Republic for years, he is a person who is friendly towards all the people he meets. And so, thanks to his immediacy, both travellers get to the homes of local residents, where they can see into their family life, as well as exceptional events, celebrations or tribal rituals. Actor Martin Písařík is also an adventurer at heart, but a novice motorcyclist, who bravely copes with the often difficult terrain or the vagaries of the motorbike.
title: Po jedné stopě

overview: Haunted by his devout mother's untimely death, the first Black Sheriff in a small Bible Belt county must lead the hunt for a serial killer that has been preying on his Black community for years in the name of God.
title: All the Sinners Bleed

overview: Murder 360 is a true crime docuseries that uncovers ten gripping murder cases from every possible angle. Through intimate interviews, expert analysis, and rare footage, the series paints a vivid portrait of the motive, method, and aftermath of each crime - from thrill killings to deadly vows.
title: Murder 360
Reborn in the 90s: Remarry and Walk the Path of Blossoms

overview: Zhong Zimo is shocked to discover that Chu Ruoyun, who closely resembles his late lover Li Yinuo, is actually Long Haotian's wife. Believing their marriage is a loveless contract, he joins forces with Li Yiran, the adopted daughter of Li Xiaohan, to bring down the Long Corporation. After being rejected by Long Haotian, Li Yiran sows discord between him and Chu Ruoyun, leading to deeper misunderstandings. Pressured by his family, Long Haotian drives the pregnant Chu Ruoyun away; she later suffers a miscarriage and is kidnapped. Zhong Zimo and Long Haotian rescue her, and Long Haotian chooses to leave his family to stay by her side. Zhong Zimo then reveals a shocking truth: Chu Ruoyun is Li Yinuo's long-lost twin, the biological daughter of the Li family, secretly switched at birth. Reunited with her true family, Chu Ruoyun overcomes all obstacles with Long Haotian, and the lingering obsessions of Zhong Zimo and Li Yiran finally come to an end.
title: Substitute for Love

overview: With populist leaders thriving and dictatorships on the rise, this series looks at Hitler from a different perspective - through his friends, enablers and associates. For the first time on television, these recorded testimonies are brought together to create a unique portrait of Hitler. Many of those featured are Nazis. Few can be trusted. But if we see Hitler through their eyes, it's possible to grasp who Hitler was and what made him possible.
title: Dictator: The Hitler Interviews

overview: Let the Devil In is a haunting and mysterious four-episode documentary series about a decades-old tragedy that destroyed one family and ignited the darkest fears of a small New Jersey town. For the first time, witnesses, friends, and community members try to make sense of the unthinkable events, some believing that Satan took hold of a vulnerable teen boy, while others believe that far more earthly demons were to blame.
title: Let the Devil In

overview: Beverly Hills Pawn is an American TV show filmed in Beverly Hills, California. It is filmed in 'The Dina Collection' pawn shop owned by Yossi Dina who appears on the show along with his employees Aria, Cory, and manager Dominique.
title: Beverly Hills Pawn

overview: Award-winning children's adventures featuring a young schoolboy who is like any other youngster - except for the fact that he keeps turning into a dog!

overview: The series begins during the wake of the family's controversy and upheaval with Todd and Julie in federal prison and follows the family as their parents are eventually pardoned, released from prison and return home. The series shows a side of the Chrisleys that has never been seen before with exclusive access to the family—Julie and Todd from prison and upon their release, Savannah, Chase, Grayson, Chloe, Nanny Faye, and for the first time, Julie's parents Harvey and Pam. The new series exposes the raw truth of the Chrisley's lives—past and present—and the reality is far different from what audiences have seen before. The family faces a critical point that will either make their bond stronger or leave it shattered forever. This series delivers an unfiltered, deeply personal look at their journey and introduces the real Chrisleys as they navigate this new chapter.
title: The Chrisleys: Back to Reality

overview: Killer Class tracks the unexpected formation of a HS Forensics Club that proves shockingly effective at solving real cold cases.
title: Killer Class

overview: Povratak Otpisanih is the direct sequel to Otpisani, continuing the story of the same resistance fighters, primarily Prle and Tihi, as they take on new missions in occupied Belgrade. While maintaining the tone and style of the original, the sequel introduces more complex plots and deeper character dynamics, further developing the narrative established in the first series.
title: Povratak Otpisanih

overview: Is Støre jealous of Stoltenberg? How good is Listhaug at English? Does Vedum have an alibi for September 11? Video podcast with Erlend Mørch and the political leaders.

overview: Dalma Maradona travels to the places she shared with her father and tries to understand how she came to be called "the daughter of God."
title: La Hija de Dios: Dalma Maradona

overview: Cajun Pawn Stars is an American reality television series on the History channel that debuted January 8, 2012, at 10pm. The show was a spin-off of Pawn Stars. The show revolves around another family-owned pawn shop, the Silver Dollar Pawn & Jewelry Center in Alexandria, Louisiana, which is owned by Jimmie "Big Daddy" DeRamus, who runs the store along with his wife Peggy, his brother Johnnie, and daughter Tammie. Assisting the DeRamuses are employees Tina Journet, and Robby Friend. The shop claims to have over 100,000 items within its 20,000 square foot showroom.
title: Cajun Pawn Stars

overview: Xu Haimeng, heiress to the Yunhai Group, enters into a political marriage with the eldest son of the newly wealthy Lu family. Shortly after their wedding, the couple travels abroad for their honeymoon only to tragically drown in an unexpected accident. On the very day the Lu family holds a shareholders' meeting to seize control of Yunhai Group, Xu Haimeng suddenly returns. Not only has she risen from the ashes, but she stages a dramatic comeback, taking back Yunhai with overwhelming force. This leads to a complete falling-out with the Lu family. Lu Siyu, the younger son, becomes her fiercest rival, suspicious of her true identity and determined to uncover the truth behind his brother's death. As the two clash repeatedly, caught in a web of secrets and danger, Lu Siyu finally uncovers the truth about the "deadly honeymoon": Xu Haimeng had been pushed off a cliff by his brother and barely survived after a harrowing struggle between life and death. Everyone believed Xu Haimeng had returned to avenge her husband, but in reality, she came back to expose the true mastermind who ordered her murder. The shocking twist changes Lu Siyu's view of her, and the two go from enemies to reluctant allies, gradually growing closer. But just when things seem to settle, a new blow strikes. Lu Siyu turns out to be the legal beneficiary of Yunhai Group after the attempted murder. Devastated, Xu Haimeng cuts ties with him completely, and in doing so, uncovers a massive, long-buried scandal within the Lu family. Through unwavering resilience, she secures Yunhai's future. Lu Siyu, finally letting go of the betrayal from his family, comes to terms with his pain. Supporting each other through the storm, they rebuild the Yunhai Group and step forward onto a brand-new path in life together.
title: The Return of the Queen

overview: In the early Republican era, Shu Yan, a street performer, is knocked unconscious and kidnapped. When she wakes up, she is shocked to find herself transformed into the wife of Yan Qizhao, the influential president of a prominent trade association. An esteemed husband, endless gold and silver adornments, obedient servants—every piece of evidence confirms her identity as the president's wife. Yet, Shu Yan grows increasingly certain that something is shrouded in mystery. Yan Qizhao's tender care gradually draws her in, but soon, she discovers it is all part of a deadly trap he had meticulously set from the very beginning.
title: Hidden Love

overview: The teacher of the Semyonov Faculty of Philology, the most spineless being on the planet, is possessed by an alien whose ship has crashed. To his horror, the alien learns that humanity is burning oil, which was created by scientists of their more advanced civilization as a cure for all diseases. He wants to warn the "tribesmen" so that together they can clear the Land of "pest people." But to do this, you need to repair the ship in a quiet place. However, he is not allowed to retire by Semenov's daughter Alyona, his ex-wife Katya, the dean, the commandant, a ufologist, and a strong passion for his colleague Anna Mikhailovna.
title: Осторожно, люди!

overview: A wedding reality show in which Russian-American actor Daniel Barnes, known as American Dani, will watch and comment on the celebrations. He is well acquainted with American canons, and now he will immerse himself in Russian traditions. The host will evaluate the outfits of the bride and groom, the decoration of the hall, the music, the dishes and the general atmosphere. He will also dispel stereotypes, play games from the toastmaster and learn holiday terminology.
title: Свадьба по-русски! с америкашкой Дэни

overview: A game show in which hens compete to see which one can keep from clucking the longest? And in which goldfish play croquet and hamsters take part in a Grand Prix? It sounds unbelievable but this series promises just that. In each programme's five rounds animals of the same species strive to win prizes for their owners in games such as That's My Stick Insect and Tortoise Speed Marathon. The owner of the overall winner gets the chance to play for a holiday by answering questions, not surprisingly, on animals. It tests the imagination but in future shows cows, hamsters, snails and ferrets all get to take part.
title: Pets Win Prizes

overview: Death Caetana, the terrible ounce winged, flying over the hinterland where a circus troupe led by an old clown comes to a village. The old clown open a thick book and begins the representation of an enigmatic novel, heroic and memorialistic: The Stone of the Kingdom. The clown is Pedro Dinis Quaderna, the protagonist of the novel, already aged, and the representation of the content will be his own memories. The old clown recalls the moment, "arrested and prematurely aged by suffering , after 41 years" wrote the novel in the public chain Taperoá.
title: A Pedra do Reino

overview: Kim Yong-ho fitness coach of Hollywood stars. He grew up in a wealthy family, but no amount of money could not save him from getting childhood trauma, after which he is still trying to recover. Kang Eun Joo 33 years old, she was a lawyer. Problems of her family take up all her strength and the brand has neither the time nor the money. And because of this, it certainly can not be called a harmonious and attractive.
title: Oh My Venus

overview: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.
title: Dear X

overview: In 1984, serial killer Ted Bundy offers to help investigator Robert Keppel catch The Green River killer, a phantom who was murdering women in Seattle, Washington - right where Bundy claimed many of his victims, ten years earlier. Keppel and Bundy's cat and mouse game, played out up until Bundy was executed. Exclusive elements in the form of never-before-heard audio tapes and interviews combine to make "Ted Bundy: Dialogue with the Devil" the definitive deep dive into one of history's darkest minds - seen through the steadfast gaze of the detective who refused to look away.
title: Ted Bundy: Dialogue With the Devil

overview: Get ready for betrayal, banter and behind-the-scenes bombshells with The Traitors Ireland: Uncloaked, a brand-new companion show to the highly anticipated The Traitors Ireland that will air directly after the programme across RTÉ platforms later this year. Comedian, actor, and presenter Kevin McGahern will act as our mischievoushost with Uncloaked promising to be the ultimate post-show destination for fans across Ireland. As soon as viewers have finished with their latest fix of The Traitors Ireland on RTÉ One and RTÉ Player, they'll be able to join Kevin, celebrity guests and players from the show for all the best analysis and reaction to the latest betrayals, mind games and manipulations. Uncloaked will take fans of The Traitors Ireland deeper into Slane Castle with dissection of the episodes and exclusive access to the banished and murdered players. This access all areas show will be available on RTÉ television, RTÉ Player and all podcast platforms. Filmed in RTÉ Limerick, each episode will feature an exclusive interview with the banished or murdered player as well bonus unseen footage. Kevin will have celebrity guests from the world of comedy, music, sport and entertainment, who will give their opinion on the goings on within the castle walls. Whether it's their first time tuning in or they're longtime The Traitors fans, guests will share who they're backing, who they suspect and who they'd banish without hesitation. Don't miss a moment of the drama, watch The Traitors Ireland Uncloaked after every episode of The Traitors Ireland, later this year on RTÉ.
title: The Traitors Ireland Uncloaked

overview: Outcast as a demon since birth, Bai Xiaoying walks the path of immortality for one reason: revenge. A soul-bond with Ye Chenyuan, Night God, sparks an impossible love. Ye Chenyuan dies to unlock her true strength and reveal the Immortal Master pulling every string. Together with loyal friends, she kills the Immortal Master and breaks the Night God's reign. Ye Chenyuan fades into a fading sword spirit. She guards it for centuries until the day it sings his name again.
title: The Sun in the Dark

overview: Born into poverty, Chen Yuanqi sacrificed everything to support his beloved's education, only to be betrayed and left for dead. After awakening to divine powers from a fatal fall, he vows to defy fate and rewrite his destiny. Joined by an aloof saintess, a seductive demon queen, and a spirited spirit clansprite, he embarks on path of vengeance, crushing noble houses, obliterating demonic sects, and challenging the heavens themselves. With mortal flesh, he defies the laws of the immortal realm. As humanity teeters on the brink, he burns his very essence to shatter the chains of predestination, fighting for a chance to overturn destiny for all.
title: Go Up Against The Immortal

overview: World's Wildest Police Videos is an American reality TV series that deals with police videos from across the world. Video footage of car chases, subsequent arrests, robberies,riots and other crimes appear on the show. The series ran on Fox from 1998–2002, although episodes were only broadcast up until 2001, when the show shortened its name to "Police Videos". The Original series ran from April 2, 1998 – July 27, 2001 In 2012, Spike announced that it had commissioned 13 new episodes with the revival of the original name and John Bunnell returning as host, which premiered on May 7, 2012 and ended on August 13, 2012.
title: World's Wildest Police Videos

overview: At the heart of the series lies one secret, two mothers, and a single heart — a story of hidden truths, unexpected connections, and love that emerges from the shadows of the past.
title: Çarpıntı

overview: Believe Me tells the story of three victims of one of the most prolific sex attackers in British history, John Worboys, dubbed by the media as the ‘black cab rapist' after preying on women under the cover of being a ‘respectable' licensed taxi-cab driver.
title: Believe Me

overview: A story that follows an unprecedented incident, in which a married man newly elected as president demands a divorce from his wife, who is to become the first lady. It unfolds during the 67 days leading up to the presidential inauguration, depicting the political intrigue and family secrets that emerge through the intense conflict between the president-elect and his wife.
title: First Lady

overview: In Magnolia Table: At the Farm, Joanna welcomes viewers into her home to share cherished family recipes and seasonal favorites - from quick snacks to Sunday treats. Along the way, she offers helpful cooking tips, celebrates the beauty of fresh ingredients, and invites audiences to enjoy the simple pleasures of time spent in some of her favorite spaces around the farm.
title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm

overview: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler Award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch, and has finally found the right client and idea to make it a reality.
title: Bitchin Rides Road To The Ridler

overview: Captain Noémie Chastain investigates a submerged village after the discovery of a child's skeleton. A captivating thriller miniseries, combining buried secrets, human drama, and a quest for truth.
title: Surface

overview: Coach Trip is a travel-meets-reality show where a coach load of Brits set off on a six- week trip around Europe. Stopping off at a wealth of destinations on their way, but confined to a coach, tensions run high when people are forced to spend too much time together. But this is a Coach Trip with a difference, because couples that become just too annoying will be voted off by their fellow coach trippers dropped off at the nearest station and sent home. It's a tough job for professional tour guide Brendon, whose patience is tested daily as he herds 14 people around. There are arguments, parties and travel sickness to contend with all mixed up with some of the most amazing sights in Europe.
title: Coach Trip
Le Patriarche, le gourou des drogués

overview: Mahinur Kılıçtan, a hard-working mother, lives in a cordial, traditional neighbourhood with her daughter, Bade and her deceitful husband, Kenan. For some time now, Bade has been frequently falling ill, forcing Mahinur to leave her job as a cleaner at one of the Yılmazer Holding hospitals. Now, she bears the entire responsibility of providing for her family by taking on temporary cleaning jobs. Aras Yılmazer, Mahinur's former employer, lives in a family mansion that has been passed down through generations, sharing the grand residence with his daughter Derin, his mother Selvihan, his aunt Leyla, and his cousin Ejder. Aras's wife, Banu, tragically passed away due to certain complications during their daughter's birth. After her death, although Aras refrained from pursuing a new relationship for some time, he eventually became engaged to Pelin—a woman from a similarly prominent family and now a management executive at the hospital—to provide Derin with a stable family life. When fate reveals the heart-wrenching truth that Mahinur and Aras's daughters, Bade and Derin, were switched at birth, a devoted mother and a businessman find their worlds colliding in unimaginable ways. Bound by the desperate need to save the life of Bade, who was diagnosed with hemolytic anaemia, they enter into a marriage of convenience to bring a sibling into the world, who can become a stem cell donor. Yet, as they navigate the delicate threads of secrets, sacrifices, and a carefully crafted facade, an unexpected love begins to blossom—turning their unlikely union into a tale of redemption, healing, and the power of the heartstrings.
title: Can Bağı

overview: A romantic story between a photographer and a model from an erotic magazine, as they shoot a film that belongs only to the two of them, right in the heart of Kyoto.
title: Lost in Kyoto

overview: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.
title: Insight with Haslinda Amin

overview: For the first time, 6 experts from M6 will be brought together and participate together in a unique general knowledge game. In front of them, 100 candidates who think they are better than them on their subject of expertise: cooking, science and health, music, home, news, fashion, sport, entertainment, etc. Their goal: to beat the M6 experts. So, will a candidate be strong enough to beat the M6 experts or will the latter manage to hold their rank?
title: Qui peut nous battre ?

overview: When an undercover agent discovers a plan involving a nuclear weapon, a battle-hardened spymaster must revisit his clandestine history to thwart a catastrophe.
title: Salakaar

overview: Three millennial young women try to make the best of their modest finances and comical misadventures while trying to live their best lives
title: Broke & Sexy

overview: The Box will see a dozen celebrities placed at mercy of The Box. Each famous face enter a box and are transferred to a different location. When the box opens at the new location, the famous faces must face whatever is in front of them - with no prior warning on what or who may be on the other side of the box or the task they will have to complete.
title: The Box

overview: This complicated drama/war epic follows the life of Kozaks, special cavalry troops of Russian monarchy from the end of 19th century, through the 1918 Revolution and civil war that followed.
title: Тихий Дон

overview: Dale Winton hosts Touch the Truck, an endurance game show for Channel 5. A group of 20 contestants keep their hand on a stationary Toyota Land Cruiser Amazon truck and the last one touching it wins the truck.
title: Touch the Truck

overview: Miranda returns to Mexico to uncover her family history and learns that her mother did not abandon her, but that she was kidnapped at birth. Finding her mother in a psychiatric hospital, suffering from the effects of abuse and violence, Miranda decides to work her way into the heart of a criminal organization to uncover the truth about what happened and make sure those responsible are punished.
title: Quebranto
